mapper.sql: ast06_tr_id AS tr_id, ast06_date AS date, ast06_tr_cd AS tr_code, ast06_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id, f_ast_class_tree_nm(ast06_ast_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_name, ast06_deposit_id AS deposit_id, b.ast01_class_tree_nm AS deposit_name, ast06_corp_id AS corp_id, ast06_cur_cd AS cur_code, ast06_amt AS amt, ast06_fee AS fee, ast06_note AS note, ast06_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(ast06_person_id) AS person_name, act02_journal_id AS journal_id, ast06_appr_id AS appr_id, CASE WHEN act02_journal_id IS NULL THEN ( SELECT count(*) FROM act80_relate_appr INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = act80_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_journal_id = act80_journal_id WHERE ( act80_tr_id IN ( SELECT ast06_tr_id UNION SELECT ast07_settle_id FROM ast07_settle WHERE ast07_tr_id = ast06_tr_id ) OR act02_tr_id IN ( SELECT ast06_tr_id UNION SELECT ast07_settle_id FROM ast07_settle WHERE ast07_tr_id = ast06_tr_id ) ) AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') ) ELSE f_get_relate_dcr_count(act02_journal_id) END || ' 건' AS appr_cnt

FROM ast06_tr INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree a ON a.ast01_class_tree_id = ast06_ast_class_tree_id /* 출금계좌정보 */ INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree b ON b.ast01_class_tree_id = ast06_deposit_id /* 입금계좌정보 */ LEFT OUTER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_tr_id = ast06_tr_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE COALESCE(a.ast01_asset_type, '1') LIKE '1' AND ast06_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate} AND #{c.closeDate} AND ast06_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND ast06_tr_cd = '9005' AND COALESCE(ast06_cur_cd, 'KRW') = 'KRW'
AND #{c.accountId} IN (ast06_ast_class_tree_id, ast06_deposit_id)
AND ( ( #{c.userId} IN ( SELECT ast06_person_id UNION ALL SELECT ast10_person_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '1' AND ast10_link_id IN (ast06_tr_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id) ) ) OR ( #{c.orgId} IN ( SELECT ast10_org_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '2' AND ast10_link_id IN (ast06_tr_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(f_get_empTrans(ast06_person_id, to_date(substr(ast06_tr_id || '', 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd'), 'org_code_id') AS NUMERIC) ) ) ) ORDER BY ast06_date, ast06_tr_id
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ast01_cur_cd, ''), 'KRW') FROM ast01_class_tree WHERE ast01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast06_tr (ast06_tr_id, ast06_company_id, ast06_person_id, ast06_date, ast06_tr_cd, ast06_amt, ast06_fee, ast06_note, ast06_ast_class_tree_id, ast06_deposit_id, ast06_corp_id, ast06_cur_cd, ast06_for_amt, ast06_fx_rate, ast06_book_amt, ast06_settle_mng_yn) VALUES (#{trId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{r.date}, '9005', #{r.amt}, #{r.fee}, #{r.note}, #{r.astClassTreeId}, #{r.depositId}, #{r.corpId}, #{curCode}, #{r.amt}, 1, #{bookAmt}, 'false')
mapper.update: UPDATE ast06_tr SET ast06_amt = #{r.amt}, ast06_fee = #{r.fee}, ast06_note = #{r.note}, ast06_ast_class_tree_id = #{r.astClassTreeId}, ast06_deposit_id = #{r.depositId}, ast06_corp_id = #{r.corpId}, ast06_cur_cd = #{curCode}, ast06_for_amt = #{r.amt}, ast06_fx_rate = 1, ast06_book_amt = #{bookAmt} WHERE ast06_tr_id = #{r.trId} AND ast06_company_id = #{companyId}
